title: Leoflow Project Configuration
description: Developer-facing configuration. Consumed by 'leoflow compile' to build a container image and generate dag.json.

python_version.description: Python line of the published task base image (ghcr.io/dexadata/leoflow-runtime:py<version>). This enum is the single source of truth for which base images the release publishes; scripts/check-python-runtime-matrix.sh fails when the release matrix, the Makefile, runtime/Dockerfile or the configuration reference disagree with it. 3.10 is deprecated and stops being published after its 2026-10-31 upstream EOL.

3.10.reason: Python 3.10 reaches upstream end-of-life on 2026-10-31. docker-library/python stops rebuilding an EOL line the day after (python:3.9-slim was last rebuilt 2025-11-01, one day after 3.9 went EOL), so python:3.10-slim — and therefore leoflow-runtime:py3.10 — stops receiving OS security updates and accumulates unfixed CVEs indefinitely.

base_image.description: Override the image the DAG is built FROM. Default: the published Leoflow task base for python_version (ghcr.io/dexadata/leoflow-runtime:py<python_version>, pinned to the CLI's release tag). Setting this makes python_version unused for the FROM, so a pin to a deprecated py<line> tag is not fixed by changing python_version — repoint this field. Pinning also freezes the interpreter and OS packages at whatever the base carried the day you pinned it (ADR 0003).

connectors.description: Short connector names (e.g. 'postgres', 'http') expanded at compile to their apache-airflow-providers-* packages. Sugar over dependencies; advanced users can pin via dependencies instead.

connections.description: Managed connection ids this DAG declares (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). A task receives a connection only if declared; per-task narrowing is available under tasks. Distinct from connectors: (pip provider packages, ADR 0038). Absent (empty) declares none.

variables.description: Airflow Variable names this DAG declares (ADR 0045, ADR 0055). A task receives a Variable only if declared; per-task narrowing is available under tasks. Absent (empty) declares none.

system_packages.description: OS packages to install via apt-get.

dag_source.description: Path to the DAG definition file relative to leoflow.yaml.

include_paths.description: Files and directories to copy into the image.

dockerfile.description: Path to a custom Dockerfile. If set, autogeneration is skipped.

defaults.description: DAG-wide task defaults. A task that declares its own value always wins; these only fill the gaps (ADR 0023). resources and node_selector are baked onto every task at compile time; retries/retry_delay/timeout flow through the parser's Airflow default_args.

resources.description: Default CPU AND memory for tasks that declare none; expanded to requests == limits so the task reaches Guaranteed QoS (#725). BOTH fields are required: that expansion is the block's only purpose, so a partial pair reaches only Burstable, and it still suppresses the per-cluster platform default the missing dimension would otherwise have come from (#802). Set both, or omit the block.

node_selector.description: Default pod placement for tasks that declare no execution.node_selector of their own.

staging.description: Opt-in per-DAG-run shared RWX volume mounted at /staging (ADR 0022).

dbt.description: Declares a dbt project as the DAG source (ADR 0042); its presence routes compile to the dbt renderer instead of the Python parser.

granularity.description: Task partition strategy (ADR 0042). tag/selector grouping is tracked in issue #398.

manifest.description: Optional pre-built manifest.json path (Pro/CI baked); empty runs dbt parse.

schedule.description: Cron expression or preset (e.g. @daily); empty means unscheduled. dbt has no schedule, so it is declared here.

connection.description: Managed Leoflow connection id (ADR 0043); generates profiles.yml in the pod instead of a baked one. Use one or the other.

schema.description: Overrides the dbt target schema in the generated profile (where models materialize).

dbt_groups.description: Named dbt projects embedded as task groups in a dag.py (ADR 0043); each key is the name passed to dbt_group(name).

manifest.description: Optional pre-built manifest.json path; empty runs dbt parse.

connection.description: Managed Leoflow connection id (ADR 0043); generates profiles.yml in the pod.

schema.description: Overrides the dbt target schema in the generated profile.

alerts.description: Native on-failure alerting (#424). The scheduler fires these rules when a DagRun reaches the terminal failed state — in Go, with no task pod.

on_failure.description: Rules dispatched when the DagRun fails.

type.description: Channel: slack (incoming webhook) or webhook (generic HTTP POST).

conn.description: Managed Leoflow connection id holding the endpoint and its secret. Required — no literal URLs/tokens in leoflow.yaml.

message.description: Optional notification body, templated with run context ({{dag}}, {{run_id}}, {{task}}).

tasks.description: Per-task overrides bound by task_id (ADR 0023). Each key MUST match a task_id in the compiled DAG; an unknown id fails the compile. A set field overrides the value compiled from the DAG (task override > DAG defaults).

env.description: Environment variables merged over the task's compiled env.

connections.description: Managed connection ids this task declares, narrowing the DAG-level declaration (ADR 0045, ADR 0055).

variables.description: Airflow Variable names this task declares, narrowing the DAG-level declaration (ADR 0045, ADR 0055).

claims.description: Dynamic Resource Allocation: the pod-level resource_claims this container consumes (DRA, GA in Kubernetes 1.34).

priority_class_name.description: Ranks the task pod against neighbors on a shared cluster; the PriorityClass is platform-owned (ADR 0054).

termination_grace_period_seconds.description: Seconds to shut down before SIGKILL; omit for the cluster default.

runtime_class_name.description: Alternate container runtime registered as a RuntimeClass (e.g. sandboxed/GPU).

topology_spread_constraints.description: Spread task pods across failure domains; Kubernetes TopologySpreadConstraint entries.

affinity.description: Node/pod affinity and anti-affinity; a Kubernetes Affinity object.

resource_claims.description: Pod-level ResourceClaims for Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA, GA in Kubernetes 1.34).

labels.description: Pod labels merged onto the task pod; Leoflow's leoflow.io/* labels win collisions.

annotations.description: Pod annotations merged onto the task pod; Leoflow's task-instance-id annotation wins collisions.
